mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias in patients taking amiodarone, which already carries significant arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) closely before and after zoledronic acid infusion; consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; ensure adequate supplementation of depleted electrolytes.
